cves.summary: NVIDIA Triton Inference Server for Linux contains a vulnerability where an attacker can cause an authentication bypass through an alternative path or channel. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to code
cves.headline: Triton Inference Server on Linux has an authentication bypass through an alternative path

name: Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel
title: CWE-288: Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel
ai_text: In AI software this weakness shows up in model serving, where a network service exposes more than one way in. CVE-2026-47481 is the example here, filed against Triton Inference Server on Linux, an authentication bypass through an alternative path. The product expects callers to authenticate, but a second route into the same server skips that check, so a request that never passes the login step is still handled. An attacker who can reach that alternate path gets the access the normal path would have denied, which in a serving product means reaching the models and endpoints behind it. The CVEs given cover only this one product, so the pattern is a serving layer with a second, unguarded channel.
description: The product requires authentication, but the product has an alternate path or channel that does not require authentication.

mitigations.description: Funnel all access through a single choke point to simplify how users can access a resource. For every access, perform a check to determine if the user has permissions to access the resource.
